public_output.executive_summary: Among U.S. adults aged 18+ in 2021, 17% had bought or sold cryptocurrency, while 4% had paid for a product or service with it. Activate forecasts global internet and media revenues to rise from $2.1T in 2021E to $2.5T in 2025E, adding $390B in growth dollars at a 4.3% CAGR. For 2021E–2025E, Activate forecasts global advertising revenue to grow at a 6.9% CAGR, compared with paid content at 2.2% and internet access at 3.8%. In the U.S. in 2021, 60% of gamers, defined as adults aged 18+ who currently played video games, had participated in non-gaming activities or events within games in the last 12 months. If evaluating consumer cryptocurrency activity, MarketLense recommends tracking buying or selling separately from paying for a product or service.
